You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Cypress Semiconductor / SK hynix system ic NAND joint venture, realized ~2021–2023 record

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. The outcome window is fixed at approximately three
> to five years after the ~2018 closing (i.e. 2021–2023). Because the registrant was
> acquired whole and deregistered in 2020, there is no in-window public annual report;
> the realized record is traced through the deregistration filing and reputable press.
> This sub-dossier contains no information about how the transaction was structured at
> closing.

## Public-reporting status during the outcome window (feasibility-relevant)
- On June 3, 2019, Cypress Semiconductor Corporation, Infineon Technologies AG, and IFX Merger Sub Inc. (a wholly-owned subsidiary of Infineon) entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger; on April 16, 2020, Merger Sub merged with and into the Company, with the Company surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Infineon. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-20-051192, Form 15-12B]
- The Company filed a Form 15-12B on April 27, 2020 certifying termination of the registration of its common stock under the Securities Exchange Act. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-20-051192, Form 15-12B]
- The Company's last annual report on Form 10-K was filed February 21, 2020 for fiscal year 2019; no Form 10-K or Form 20-F was filed by the Company for any period in the 2021–2023 outcome window, so no audited public financial statement of the Company or its interest in the joint venture exists for that window. [SRC: SEC accession 0000791915-20-000006, Form 10-K (FY2019, last annual report filed)]

## Realized record of the joint venture during the window (press-sourced, non-scalar)
- The joint venture received regulatory antitrust approval and began full operations on April 1, 2019 as SkyHigh Memory Limited, a Hong Kong–based NAND supplier. [SRC: https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/cypress-announces-closing-joint-venture-transaction-[REDACTED:api_key]]
- Within the outcome window the joint venture continued to operate as a going concern: on October 11, 2021 SkyHigh Memory announced an expansion of its single-level-cell (SLC) NAND Flash memory family (the ML-3 product line) on 1xnm process technology, with devices described as available for sampling in early 2022. [SRC: https://www.storagenewsletter.com/2021/10/19/skyhigh-memory-slc-nand-flash-memory-family-on-1xnm-process-technology/]
- The joint venture continued to be described in this period as jointly established by the former Cypress (by then part of Infineon Technologies AG) and SK hynix, indicating the Company's minority interest passed to Infineon on the 2020 acquisition rather than being unwound at that time. [SRC: https://www.storagenewsletter.com/2021/10/19/skyhigh-memory-slc-nand-flash-memory-family-on-1xnm-process-technology/]

## Items sought but not primary-verifiable (coded uncertain)
- No public audited financial scalar for the joint venture or for the equity-method interest in the 2021–2023 window — net income/loss, impairment/write-down of the interest, dividends received, or a divestiture of the interest — could be located: the Company deregistered in April 2020, and neither Infineon nor SK hynix separately discloses the joint venture's standalone results in a retrievable primary SEC filing. This portion of the realized record is therefore **uncertain**. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-20-051192, Form 15-12B]
- Any figure for the joint venture's post-2020 revenue, profit, or the carrying value of the interest is [UNVERIFIED].

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because the registrant was acquired whole by Infineon and deregistered in April 2020, there is no in-window public audited outcome record for the ~2021–2023 horizon, and the case is **uncertain** on any financial outcome scalar; the traceable realized record is limited to reputable press showing that the joint venture (SkyHigh Memory Limited) survived the acquisition, remained under its two parents' ownership (with the Company's minority interest passing to Infineon), and continued as an operating NAND supplier that was still launching new SLC NAND product lines in 2021–2022. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-20-051192, Form 15-12B] [SRC: https://www.storagenewsletter.com/2021/10/19/skyhigh-memory-slc-nand-flash-memory-family-on-1xnm-process-technology/]

[SLICE END]
